verdict.rationale: Solid builds on JSX and TypeScript, its components are plain JavaScript functions, and the project says you 'don't have to learn a new rendering system'; a `<div>` is a real DOM div. Developers coming from React and Vue describe it as approachable, intuitive, and 'like React but easier to understand'. Users also report Solid-specific concepts they had to learn: destructuring props can lose reactivity, props must be passed as functions, and the props object needs special handling. Others see JSX as more verbose than plain HTML. missing for 10: no evidence on styling/CSS authoring, and the props-reactivity rules add new concepts that cut against 'minimal new concepts'.
